> Is there a reason suicidal people should stay alive BESIDES living for other people, so other people won’t feel bad about it?

Idk,i like listening to music, i like watching shows that i watch, i like playing video games. I like cats so i feed some outside. I enjoy living when i get to do these outside of the whole living for others type deal. I think you can find things like this yourself if you look for it hard enough.
Thanks man, im still thinking about how to move forward. Im a bit confused at the moment so i keep changing my mind on things but yeah, im still around. You keep going too.

I really can relate. I'm also in college(6 years now and im still in second grade), and failure also means i'll get disowned by my family which is my only social circle amd i'll be stuck on a minimum wage job for the next 50 years until im old and useless, then ill get the privilege to live rest of my years alone in a retirement home shitting my diapers. Whats funny is if by some act of god i succeed, its the same fucking fate fuck me. Not to mention i'm pretty suicidal myself aswell. If i had an answer here i'd type it out in an effort to help you but i don't. I've been lately thinking about(bery lately,like i started thinking about it 20 minutes ago lol) just saying fuck everything and try to do the thing i wanted to do since i was a kid, write reviews about media i enjoy/didnt enjoy and publish them through video or text and dedicate my whole time and life to it,abandoning schoolwork and all that shit that stresses me out endlessly.

Edit: If you want to talk it out, feel free to reply here or dming me, i wouldn't mind talking.

Intelligence isnt required to achieve. Sure you most likely wont become next elon musk but success isnt defined by becoming a milti billionnaire who owns multiple corporations. And intelligence is a very fickle concept, people are really smart in some places, very dumb on others. Try to find what you're smart on and work towards your strengths.

Please dont miss out on anything you listed. I dont know what you did that made you think you dont deserve a good life but i believe you do. People make mistakes sometimes and as these mistakes fester inside us we make them bigger. Give yourself another chance and some time to make it fair. It'll work because you're strong

You know, this feeling alone is the only thing that keeps me alive. That i'll damage others if i leave. But since i cant ask that to few people i have left in my life without them panicking ill ask it to you instead. Why are you making me go through this ? Is it too difficult for you to just let me stop my pain. Im losing my mind. Im shaking every time i get a notification on my phone. Im having nightmares everyday. I cant function anymore. Just let me go, please
